title: Certified authored-circle components and endpoint correspondence
decision: retain authored-circle support certification, complete conjugate residual contacts, and replay fixes while deleting duplicate seeding and redundant mapped-root ordering; overall release readiness remains open

milestone_status.exactcorelib_mining_and_recorded_uplift: closed before this checkpoint; no new milestone closure

source.public_api: unchanged; no compatibility interface, alias, shim, or alternate solver
source.behavior: Before a norm-zero circle component is admitted, the existing selected-field identity proof certifies the unsquared authored equation. A conjugate-only norm descends through its nonzero coefficient into the same finite-contact kernel. The identity helper borrows both coefficient polynomials. Rational-circle component boundaries use the shared complete finite-fiber authority, including centers that refine to Exact. On certified authored support, complete angular-root partitions certify strict cell order directly. Cell/contact evidence is classified before the one shared map captures the consumed construction policy; three polynomial clones and repeated mapped-root ordering are removed. One orientation-aware endpoint correspondence serves forward mapping, inversion, and location; point publication validates requested policy before returning evidence.

regressions.baseline: All four tests fail with old production: exact-center boundary seeding panics; certified overlap and isolated component-contact publication reject STRICT replay after APPROXIMATE_512 construction; conjugate circles publish false overlap arcs instead of a tangent contact or empty result.
regressions.intermediate: The seeding/publication-only candidate passes isolated-contact replay but the overlap matrices expose incorrect reversed endpoints. The first orientation-corrected candidate passed all eleven gates yet a follow-up geometric probe exposed false conjugate overlaps. Original main reproduces that defect too. Fifty-seven superseded qualification/profile/build artifacts plus their source diff remain under initial-qualification; they are not the final results. The support-before driver initially rejected ambiguous full/minimal executables (exit124, no regression ran); using Cargo’s reported executable produced the recorded false-overlap failure.
regressions.candidate: All four pass across exact-refining and genuinely algebraic centers, both circle/source traversals and requested policies. Conjugate unit circles with center separations two/four retain exactly their tangent contact/no contacts, while genuine nonzero-offset authored quarters retain their overlaps. Exact endpoint/interior points and angular parameters, inverse correspondence, tangency and real terminal consumption/rejection are checked. The existing folded-component test and region Boolean consumers remain in the full suite.
regressions.artifacts_scope: The early baseline has two new tests before formatting; matched-baseline has three. Authored-baseline carries the byte-identical final conversion_tests module with all four new tests and the same 907-test catalog as the candidate. Authored-baseline, not the early or intermediate binaries, supplies unit timing and heap controls.

no_default_features.ignored_coverage: all four opt-in tests pass in the full run

build_control.dependencies: All six crate sources are archived from their recorded HEADs. No dependency points into a concurrent live worktree. All live Hyperreal edits are excluded, including formatting, inverse-trigonometric/hyperbolic, and logarithm drafts.
build_control.unit_features: all features including dispatch-trace and comparative-benchmarks; matching 907-test catalogs and byte-identical measured folded-overlap test body
build_control.native_benchmark_features: default features; three named release benchmarks
build_control.timing_context: Three alternating pairs and seven additional native pairs pinned to CPU 7 after owned qualification/build/profile workers completed. CPU-3 Callgrind and Heaptrack records may overlap qualification and are not wall-time comparisons.

timings.excluded_attempt: The initial driver was stopped (exit143) after observing an external eight-thread audit on CPUs8-15, including CPU7's SMT sibling. Two selected-test invocations completed; a third chord invocation has no terminal result. Six raw artifacts and a README are preserved under contended-timing-attempt and excluded from all aggregates. The final matrix restarted after the external workers disappeared; an untruncated compact host-process snapshot during round2 also found no external build/test/profile workers. Desktop load and frequency scaling remain uncontrolled.

memory.scope: Complete Heaptrack format-3 raw streams of one existing folded-overlap libtest invocation per variant, not geometry-only accounting or an ecosystem leak claim. Compressed streams validate and the streaming counter reconciles final live state. Identical test catalogs and measured test bodies; executable names differ.
memory.layout: No retained object field was added. Publication temporarily stores boundary references/locations; the final shared map takes ownership of three formerly cloned polynomial expressions.

limitations: Not a universal performance or full Hypercurve release-readiness claim.
Lower-stack and Hypermesh source are unchanged in this slice.
Concurrent Hyperreal changes remain owned by the separate reference audit and are neither committed nor qualified here.
Existing desktop processes were not stopped or controlled.
No push, publication, deployment, fresh fuzz campaign, or fresh coverage run.
followups: Audit other mapped-circle query policies together with their retained caches; this change does not certify all map-publication paths.
The independent Hyperreal audit has formatting and inverse-trigonometric/hyperbolic/logarithm range repairs in its live worktree; qualify integration after that source is finalized.

Profile-driven rational equality wide-cross-product reduction remains a candidate; test delegation to the existing exact comparison authority before adding a parallel filter. The one-item coarse-sign cleanup is separate.
Continue the single authoritative CurveRegion2 kernel/API cleanup and full release/completeness audit; this checkpoint is progress, not goal completion.

reproduction.test-regressions.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
overlap_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-overlap-publication.NCgQY3
overlap_label="$1"
cd "$overlap_root/snapshot/hypercurve"
env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --release --locked --all-features --lib --no-run > "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-build.log" 2>&1
overlap_status=$?
if (( overlap_status != 0 )); then exit "$overlap_status"; fi
mapfile -t overlap_executables < <(rg '^  Executable unittests src/lib\.rs \(' "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-build.log" | rg -o 'target/release/deps/hypercurve-[0-9a-f]+')
if (( ${#overlap_executables[@]} != 1 )); then exit 124; fi
cp "${overlap_executables[0]}" "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-test"
overlap_failed=0
for overlap_case in selected_fiber_rational_overlap_keeps_exact_center selected_fiber_rational_overlap_replays_certified_policy selected_fiber_rational_component_publishes_its_isolated_endpoint selected_fiber_rational_component_rejects_the_conjugate_circle; do
    if [[ "$overlap_label" == baseline && "$overlap_case" == selected_fiber_rational_component_publishes_its_isolated_endpoint ]]; then continue; fi
    if [[ ( "$overlap_label" == baseline || "$overlap_label" == matched-baseline ) && "$overlap_case" == selected_fiber_rational_component_rejects_the_conjugate_circle ]]; then continue; fi
    "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-test" --exact "bezier_offset::conversion_tests::$overlap_case" --nocapture > "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-$overlap_case.log" 2>&1
    overlap_status=$?
    if ! rg -q 'test result: (ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed;|FAILED\. 0 passed; 1 failed;)' "$overlap_root/$overlap_label-$overlap_case.log"; then overlap_status=125; fi
    printf '%s %s\n' "$overlap_case" "$overlap_status"
    if (( overlap_status != 0 )); then overlap_failed=1; fi
done
exit "$overlap_failed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
replay_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-overlap-publication.NCgQY3
cd "$replay_root/snapshot/hypercurve"
export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
replay_failed=0
replay_gate() {
    local replay_gate_name="$1"
    shift
    "$@" > "$replay_root/candidate-$replay_gate_name.log" 2>&1
    local replay_gate_status=$?
    printf '%s %s\n' "$replay_gate_name" "$replay_gate_status"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
replay_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-overlap-publication.NCgQY3
replay_label="$1"
cd "$replay_root/snapshot/hypercurve"
env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build --release --locked --bench bezier_region --bench rational_bezier --bench curve_region_boolean_batch > "$replay_root/$replay_label-bench-build.log" 2>&1
for replay_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier curve_region_boolean_batch; do
    replay_bins=(target/release/deps/"$replay_bench"-*)
    replay_count=0
    for replay_bin in "${replay_bins[@]}"; do
        if [[ -x "$replay_bin" && "$replay_bin" != *.d ]]; then
            cp "$replay_bin" "$replay_root/$replay_label-$replay_bench"
            replay_count=$((replay_count + 1))
        fi
    done
    if (( replay_count != 1 )); then
        printf 'ambiguous benchmark %s: %s executables\n' "$replay_bench" "$replay_count" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build --locked --manifest-path examples/hypercurve_ui/Cargo.toml --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown > "$replay_root/$replay_label-wasm-build.log" 2>&1

reproduction.paired-timings.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
replay_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/selected-overlap-publication.NCgQY3
for replay_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( replay_round % 2 )); then
        replay_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        replay_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for replay_case in selected chord radial contacts overlaps; do
        case "$replay_case" in
            selected) replay_test=selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans ;;
            chord) replay_test=recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict ;;
            radial) replay_test=recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel ;;
            contacts) replay_test=selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_contacts_in_one_fiber ;;
            overlaps) replay_test=selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_overlaps_in_one_fiber ;;
        esac
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            replay_binary="$replay_root/$replay_variant-test"
            if [[ "$replay_variant" == baseline ]]; then replay_binary="$replay_root/authored-baseline-test"; fi
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_binary" \
                "bezier_offset::conversion_tests::$replay_test" --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$replay_case" "$replay_round" "$replay_variant"
        done
    done
    for replay_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-$replay_bench" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for replay_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$replay_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$replay_fixture"
        fi
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_fixture-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done
